data.name: Query_AvgGrossSalePriceFiveYears
data.value:
--Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @DocumentTypeID int = null --Declare @AsOnDate datetime = '2021-09-30 00:00:00:000'
SELECT DTFinal.ItemCategoryID,DTFinal.CategoryName, cast(2000 + cast(left(cast(DTFinal.PeriodSetName as varchar),2) as int) as varchar)+'-'+ right(cast(DTFinal.PeriodSetName as varchar),2) FiscalYear, --DT.PeriodSetName FiscalYear, sum(Abs(DTFinal.BaseQuantity)) AS BaseQuantity, sum(isnull(DTFinal.QuantityInvoiced,0)) QuantityInvoiced, sum(isnull(DTFinal.BaseAmount,0)) BaseAmount, cast(round(sum(isnull(DTFinal.BaseAmount,0))/sum(isnull(DTFinal.QuantityInvoiced,0)),2) as decimal(18,4)) / DTFinal.UnitWeight UnitPrice FROM (
SELECT DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, DT.YYMM, DT.MMM, sum(Abs(DT.Quantity)) AS BaseQuantity, sum(isnull(DT.Quantity,0)) QuantityInvoiced, sum(isnull(DT.Value,0)) BaseAmount, cast(round(sum(isnull(DT.Value,0))/sum(isnull(DT.Quantity,0)),2) as decimal(18,4)) / UnitWeight as UnitPrice ,CurrentFiscal,PeriodSetName,UnitWeight FROM (
select t.InvoiceDate, FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'MM') MM, FORMAT (t.InvoiceDate,'yy') YY, FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'MMM') MMM, CONVERT(varchar,FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'yy')) +''+ CONVERT(varchar,FORMAT (t.InvoiceDate,'MM')) YYMM, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,t.InvoiceDate,6),4,7) [MonthName], INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, SET_PeriodCustom .EndDate as CurrentFiscal , ( (SUM(t.AmountReceivable)-SUM(t.WithHoldingAmount)) - (SUM(t.SaleTaxAmount)+SUM(t.FurtherTaxAmount)) ) as Value ,sum(isnull(t.Quantity,0)) as Quantity ,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName
,t.UnitWeight from ( select (tab.InvoiceID),(tab.BuyerNTN),(tab.BuyerCNICNo),(tab.BuyerName),(CustomerCategoryID) ,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType), (tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, sum(tab.Quantity) as Quantity,tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, sum(tab.FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount,sum(tab.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, Sum(tab.ValueSaleReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, sum(tab.FurtherTaxAmount) as FurtherTaxAmount, sum(tab.FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount,sum(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, sum(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable ,sum(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount,BuyerSTRNNumber,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone,LogoImage, CompanyFax ,sum(AdvanceAmount)AdvanceAmount , SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance)FurtherTaxAdvance ,tab.FiscalID ,tab.CompanyID ,tab.ItemCategoryID ,tab.InvoiceDate ,tab.UnitWeight from ( Select INV_Item.UnitWeight, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, --'SI' +'-'+ Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' Then 'S' else '' end as DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1) +'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, '1701B - Cane Sugar' as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as FixedSalesTaxAmount --, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount ,CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01' AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.2 end AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' ) THEN ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) -- + --( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) )) ) - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) --+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) ) ) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) / ( 100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ) ELSE ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ) END SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate) as ValueSaleReturn , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FurtherTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
-- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) As AmountReceivable
case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive else --[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end))))) end as AmountReceivable
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax
,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)FurtherTaxAdvance
from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1 Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID -- AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID) Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 --And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) -- AND InvoiceType in (26, 183, 181, 182) --AND InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @AsOnDate and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate > DATEADD(YEAR,-5,@AsOnDate) )tab
group by (tab.InvoiceID),(tab.BuyerNTN),(tab.BuyerCNICNo),(tab.BuyerName),(CustomerCategoryID) ,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType),(tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, BuyerSTRNNumber,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone, CompanyFax,LogoImage ,tab.FiscalID,tab.CompanyID,tab.ItemCategoryID,tab.InvoiceDate,tab.UnitWeight
)t
inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = t.FiscalID and SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = t.CompanyID inner JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = t.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = t.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1
Where lower(INV_SET_Category.CategoryName) not like '%Bagasse%' and lower(INV_SET_Category.CategoryName) not like '%scrap%'
group by INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,t.InvoiceDate,INV_SET_Category.CategoryID,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,t.UnitWeight
) DT GROUP BY DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, DT.YYMM, DT.MMM,CurrentFiscal,PeriodSetName,UnitWeight
UNION ALL
SELECT DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, DT.YYMM, DT.MMM, sum(Abs(DT.Quantity)) AS BaseQuantity, sum(isnull(DT.Quantity,0)) QuantityInvoiced, sum(isnull(DT.Value,0)) BaseAmount, cast(round(sum(isnull(DT.Value,0))/sum(isnull(DT.Quantity,0)),2) as decimal(18,4)) / UnitWeight as UnitPrice ,CurrentFiscal,PeriodSetName,UnitWeight FROM (
select t.InvoiceDate, FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'MM') MM, FORMAT (t.InvoiceDate,'yy') YY, FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'MMM') MMM, CONVERT(varchar,FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'yy')) +''+ CONVERT(varchar,FORMAT (t.InvoiceDate,'MM')) YYMM, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,t.InvoiceDate,6),4,7) [MonthName], INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, SET_PeriodCustom .EndDate as CurrentFiscal , ( (SUM(t.AmountReceivable)-SUM(t.WithHoldingAmount)) - (SUM(t.SaleTaxAmount)+SUM(t.FurtherTaxAmount)) ) as Value ,sum(isnull(t.Quantity,0)) as Quantity ,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName
,t.UnitWeight from (
select
SUM(QuantityInvoiced) as Quantity,tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, 0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount,sum(tab.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, SUM(ExciseDutyActualAmount) as FurtherTaxAmount, sum(tab.FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount,sum(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, sum(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable ,sum(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone,LogoImage, CompanyFax ,sum(AdvanceAmount)AdvanceAmount , SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance)FurtherTaxAdvance ,tab.FiscalID ,tab.CompanyID ,tab.ItemCategoryID ,tab.InvoiceDate ,tab.UnitWeight from (
Select * from (
Select INV_Item.UnitWeight, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, ARS.CustomerName As BilledtoName, ARS.AddressLine1 AS BilledtoAddress, ARS.ZipCode As BilledtoZipCode, ARS.PhoneNumber AS BilledtoPhone, SC.CityName As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AS DispatchNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceCode AS DeliveryOrderNo ,case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderHeader.ContractNo else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo end ContractNo ,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end as CustomerName,
Case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) Then isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0) Else format(convert(float(50), isnull(replace([SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerCNICII, '-',''),0)),'#####-#######-#') end as NTNNumber , (case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName else [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerNameII end) as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, SET_Term.Description AS Terms, INV_Item.Description As ItemDescription, SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo,
SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken as Discount ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount
,case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end AS SaleTaxAmount , case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end
as ExciseDutyActualAmount
, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID, Brokername.CustomerName as DealerName,
case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate else SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate end as SaleOrderDate
,(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,2),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end))end))) As AmountReceivable,

SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, 0 AS DispatchNo, 0 AS DeliveryOrderNo, 0 as ContractNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') as NTNNumber, '' as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, '' AS Terms, '' As ItemDescription, '' as UOMName, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, 0 as UnitPrice, 0 as TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount, 0 as FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , '0' as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, 0 as Discount ,'0' as CustomerRefNo , 0 as WithHolding, 0 as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount , 0 as SaleTaxAmount , 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount , 0 as FEDTaxAmount , 0 as WithHoldingAmount ,0 as BrokerID, '' as DealerName, '' as SaleOrderDate , Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as AmountReceivable,
Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as ActualInvoiceAmount ,'0' as DTRENo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DTREDate ,0 as AdvanceAmount,0,0 ,Convert(int,0)Inclusive from SAL_InvoiceHeader
left Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID) Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID Inner Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID
Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID
Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 )FinalTAB
Where FinalTAB.InvoiceType like '%Sales Invoice%Bagasse%' AND FinalTAB.InvoiceDate < @AsOnDate and FinalTAB.InvoiceDate > DATEADD(YEAR,-5,@AsOnDate)
)tab
group by tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount,tab.CompanyName,tab.CompanyAddressLine1,tab.CompanyAddressLine1 ,tab.CompanyAddressLine2,tab.CompanyAddressLine3,tab.CompanyZipCode,tab.CompanyCity,tab.CompanyPhone,tab.Logoimage,tab.CompanyFax,tab.FiscalID,tab.CompanyID ,tab.ItemCategoryID,tab.InvoiceDate,tab.UnitWeight
)t
inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = t.FiscalID and SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = t.CompanyID inner JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = t.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = t.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1
group by INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,t.InvoiceDate,INV_SET_Category.CategoryID,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,t.UnitWeight
) DT GROUP BY DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, DT.YYMM, DT.MMM,CurrentFiscal,PeriodSetName,UnitWeight
) DTFinal GROUP BY DTFinal.ItemCategoryID,DTFinal.CategoryName, DTFinal.PeriodSetName ,DTFinal.UnitWeight Order by FiscalYear desc

,SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType ,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType ,AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,[SAL_InvoiceDetail] .FEDFixRate FROM [SAL_InvoiceDetail] INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON INNER JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1

LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderID
Left JOIN [SAL_OrderDetail] ON [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderDetailID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderDetailID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[OrderID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[SalesOrderHeaderID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_OrderDetail].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_SET_Category] ON [INV_SET_Category].[CategoryID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemCategoryID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_SET_Category].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [INV_Item] ON [INV_Item].[ItemID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemID] AND [INV_Item].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_Item].[Status] = 1 INNER JOIN [SET_UnitofMeasure] ON [SET_UnitofMeasure].[UOMID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[ItemUnitID] AND [SET_UnitofMeasure].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN [SAL_DOVehicleInformation] ON [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[DOVehicleInformationID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[VehicleID] AND [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DOVehicleInformation].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID]
left join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoiceID = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] and SAL_InvoiceHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] and SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1
left join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType and SET_DocumentType.[CompanyID] = SAL_InvoiceHeader.[CompanyID] and SET_DocumentType.Status = 1
left join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].CustomerID and AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_DispatchHeader].CompanyID and AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1

Select TAB.InvoiceID, TAB.BuyerNTN, TAB.BuyerCNICNo,TAB.BuyerName, TAB.CustomerCategoryID, TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.Provinceid, TAB.ProvinceName, TAB.InvoiceType,TAB.DocumentType, TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.DocumentDate, TAB.SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, TAB.Rate, TAB.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, TAB.ItemName, Sum(Quantity) as Quantity, TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAB.FEDAmount, SUM(FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount, Round(SUM( SaleTaxAmount),0) as SaleTaxAmount, Sum(TAB.ValueTaxAmountReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, Round(SUM(FurtherTaxAmount),0) as FurtherTaxAmount, SUM(FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount, SUM(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable , SUM(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.CompanyAddressLine1, TAB.CompanyAddressLine2, TAB.CompanyAddressLine3, TAB.CompanyZipCode, TAB.CompanyCity, TAB.CompanyPhone, TAB.Logoimage, TAB.CompanyFax,TAB.NetAmount,Round (TAB.TaxPayable ,0) as TaxPayable ,TAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount from ( Select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN,
Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName end as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,2))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, Case --When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then '1703 - Molasses resulting from the extraction or refining of sugar' When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Billet%' then '7207A - IRON & NON-ALLOY STEEL BILLETS' end as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount,
Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ),2) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
, --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount)) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then ((
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) - --Withholding ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding)) ) / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount ) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end as SaleTaxAmount
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) as ValueTaxAmountReturn,
-- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end as FurtherTaxAmount , Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount,2) as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))),2) As AmountReceivable, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ),0) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax , --SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.Rate * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced as NetAmount, -- ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice as TaxPayable
, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)

' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode ,CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone,null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax ,0 as AdvanceAmount, 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance ,2 as Adjusted,'', 0 as FixFEDAmount from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1 and RecievingDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID And (AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)

Select TAB.InvoiceID, TAB.BuyerNTN, TAB.BuyerCNICNo,TAB.BuyerName, TAB.CustomerCategoryID, TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.Provinceid, TAB.ProvinceName, TAB.InvoiceType,TAB.DocumentType, TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.DocumentDate, TAB.SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, TAB.Rate, TAB.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, TAB.ItemName, Sum(Quantity) as Quantity, TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAB.FEDAmount, SUM(FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount, Round(SUM( SaleTaxAmount),0) as SaleTaxAmount, Sum(TAB.ValueTaxAmountReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, Round(SUM(FurtherTaxAmount),0) as FurtherTaxAmount, SUM(FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount, SUM(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable , SUM(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.CompanyAddressLine1, TAB.CompanyAddressLine2, TAB.CompanyAddressLine3, TAB.CompanyZipCode, TAB.CompanyCity, TAB.CompanyPhone, TAB.Logoimage, TAB.CompanyFax,TAB.NetAmount,Round (TAB.TaxPayable ,0) as TaxPayable ,TAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount ,Tab.ContractNo ,Tab.DealerName from ( Select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN,
Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverCNIC end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.DriverName end as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,2))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, Case --When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then '1703 - Molasses resulting from the extraction or refining of sugar' When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Billet%' then '7207A - IRON & NON-ALLOY STEEL BILLETS' end as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ),2) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
, --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount)) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) (case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end ) as SaleTaxAmount
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) as ValueTaxAmountReturn,
-- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end
as FurtherTaxAmount
, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount,2) as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))),2) As AmountReceivable, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ),0) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax , --SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount AS NetAmount, -- Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then -- ( -- case when [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice <= ((select TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 ) ) -- then -- --SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount + ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) ) -- --SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount + ((select TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount)) -- SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * (select TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 ) -- else -- SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount -- end -- ) --else --SAL_InvoiceDetail.NetAmount --end as NetAmount, SAL_ContractDetail.Rate * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced as NetAmount, ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount ,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo ,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as DealerName from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) And (SAL_ContractHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate

data.name: Query_SalesComparison
data.value:
--Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @DocumentTypeID int = null --Declare @AsOnDate datetime = '2021-03-05 00:00:00:000'
SELECT distinct INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,'Sales Qty' as SubHeading, 'M.Tons' as UOMName, convert(varchar, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate, 106) as CurrentFiscal ,sum(isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced,0)) as Value
FROM SAL_InvoiceDetail inner join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID
inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID and SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
inner JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1
WHERE SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID= @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.[Status] = 1 AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = @DocumentTypeID) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @AsOnDate and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate > DATEADD(YEAR,-(select count(distinct StartDate) from SET_PeriodCustom),@AsOnDate) group by INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,convert(varchar, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate, 106)
union all
select INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, 'Gross Sales Value' as SubHeading , 'Rs.' as UOMName, convert(varchar, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate, 106) as CurrentFiscal , ( (SUM(t.AmountReceivable)-SUM(t.WithHoldingAmount)) - (SUM(t.SaleTaxAmount) + SUM(AdvanceAmount) +SUM(t.FurtherTaxAmount)) ) as Value
from ( select

substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, 0 AS DispatchNo, 0 AS DeliveryOrderNo, 0 as ContractNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') as NTNNumber, '' as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, '' AS Terms, '' As ItemDescription, '' as UOMName, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, 0 as UnitPrice, 0 as TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount, 0 as FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , '0' as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, 0 as Discount ,'0' as CustomerRefNo , 0 as WithHolding, 0 as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount , 0 as SaleTaxAmount , 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount , 0 as FEDTaxAmount , 0 as WithHoldingAmount ,0 as BrokerID, '' as DealerName, '' as SaleOrderDate , Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as AmountReceivable,
Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as ActualInvoiceAmount ,'0' as DTRENo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DTREDate ,0 as AdvanceAmount,0,0 ,Convert(int,0)Inclusive from SAL_InvoiceHeader
left Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType
Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID Inner Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID
Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID
Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 )FinalTAB
Where FinalTAB.InvoiceType like '%Sales Invoice%Scrap%' AND FinalTAB.InvoiceDate < @AsOnDate and FinalTAB.InvoiceDate > DATEADD(YEAR,-(select count(distinct StartDate) from SET_PeriodCustom),@AsOnDate)
)tab
group by tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount,tab.CompanyName,tab.CompanyAddressLine1,tab.CompanyAddressLine1 ,tab.CompanyAddressLine2,tab.CompanyAddressLine3,tab.CompanyZipCode,tab.CompanyCity,tab.CompanyPhone,tab.Logoimage,tab.CompanyFax,tab.FiscalID,tab.CompanyID ,tab.ItemCategoryID
)t
inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = t.FiscalID and SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = t.CompanyID inner JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = t.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = t.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1 group by INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate
union all --Variance SELECT top 1 'Sugar' as CategoryName,'Sales Qty' as SubHeading, 'M.Tons' as UOMName, 'Variance' as CurrentFiscal ,100 as Value
FROM SAL_InvoiceDetail inner join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID
inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID and SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
inner JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1
WHERE SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID= @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.[Status] = 1 AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = @DocumentTypeID) AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @AsOnDate and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate > DATEADD(YEAR,-(select count(distinct StartDate) from SET_PeriodCustom),@AsOnDate) group by INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,convert(varchar, SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate, 106)

data.name: Query_SalesComparisonMonthWise
data.value:
--Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @DocumentTypeID int = null --Declare @AsOnDate datetime = '2021-09-30 00:00:00:000'
SELECT DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, DT.YYMM, DT.MMM, sum(Abs(DT.Quantity)) AS BaseQuantity, sum(isnull(DT.Quantity,0)) QuantityInvoiced, sum(isnull(DT.Value,0)) BaseAmount, cast(round(sum(isnull(DT.Value,0))/sum(isnull(DT.Quantity,0)),2) as decimal(18,4)) / UnitWeight as UnitPrice ,CurrentFiscal,PeriodSetName FROM (
select t.InvoiceDate, FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'MM') MM, FORMAT (t.InvoiceDate,'yy') YY, FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'MMM') MMM, CONVERT(varchar,FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'yy')) +''+ CONVERT(varchar,FORMAT (t.InvoiceDate,'MM')) YYMM, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,t.InvoiceDate,6),4,7) [MonthName], INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, SET_PeriodCustom .EndDate as CurrentFiscal , ( (SUM(t.AmountReceivable)-SUM(t.WithHoldingAmount)) - (SUM(t.SaleTaxAmount)+SUM(t.FurtherTaxAmount)) ) as Value ,sum(isnull(t.Quantity,0)) as Quantity ,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName
,t.UnitWeight from ( select (tab.InvoiceID),(tab.BuyerNTN),(tab.BuyerCNICNo),(tab.BuyerName),(CustomerCategoryID) ,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType), (tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, sum(tab.Quantity) as Quantity,tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, sum(tab.FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount,sum(tab.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, Sum(tab.ValueSaleReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, sum(tab.FurtherTaxAmount) as FurtherTaxAmount, sum(tab.FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount,sum(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, sum(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable ,sum(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount,BuyerSTRNNumber,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone,LogoImage, CompanyFax ,sum(AdvanceAmount)AdvanceAmount , SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance)FurtherTaxAdvance ,tab.FiscalID ,tab.CompanyID ,tab.ItemCategoryID ,tab.InvoiceDate ,tab.UnitWeight from ( Select INV_Item.UnitWeight, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, --'SI' +'-'+ Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' Then 'S' else '' end as DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1) +'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, '1701B - Cane Sugar' as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ) as FixedSalesTaxAmount --, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount ,CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate > '2019-07-01' AND SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG > case when (AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 or AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1) then 70.2 else 70.2 end AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' ) THEN ( ( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) -- + --( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) )) ) - ( ( ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * ( isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].PricePerKG,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) --+ ( CASE WHEN ( [SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' -- AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Sugar%' -- AND AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 -- ) THEN 3.60 -- ELSE 0 -- END ) ) ) ) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) / ( 100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding ) ) ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / ( 100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ) ELSE ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / 100 ) END SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate) as ValueSaleReturn , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FurtherTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
-- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) As AmountReceivable
case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive else --[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end))))) end as AmountReceivable
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax
,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)FurtherTaxAdvance
from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1 Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID -- AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID) Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 --And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) -- AND InvoiceType in (26, 183, 181, 182) --AND InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @AsOnDate and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate > DATEADD(YEAR,-(select count(distinct StartDate) from SET_PeriodCustom),@AsOnDate) )tab
group by (tab.InvoiceID),(tab.BuyerNTN),(tab.BuyerCNICNo),(tab.BuyerName),(CustomerCategoryID) ,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType),(tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, BuyerSTRNNumber,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone, CompanyFax,LogoImage ,tab.FiscalID,tab.CompanyID,tab.ItemCategoryID,tab.InvoiceDate,tab.UnitWeight
)t

Where lower(INV_SET_Category.CategoryName) not like '%Bagasse%' and lower(INV_SET_Category.CategoryName) not like '%scrap%'
group by INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,t.InvoiceDate,INV_SET_Category.CategoryID,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,t.UnitWeight
) DT GROUP BY DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, DT.YYMM, DT.MMM,CurrentFiscal,PeriodSetName,UnitWeight
UNION ALL
