select t.InvoiceDate, FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'MM') MM, FORMAT (t.InvoiceDate,'yy') YY, FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'MMM') MMM, CONVERT(varchar,FORMAT(t.InvoiceDate,'yy')) +''+ CONVERT(varchar,FORMAT (t.InvoiceDate,'MM')) YYMM, SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,t.InvoiceDate,6),4,7) [MonthName], INV_SET_Category.CategoryID as ItemCategoryID, INV_SET_Category.CategoryName, SET_PeriodCustom .EndDate as CurrentFiscal , ( (SUM(t.AmountReceivable)-SUM(t.WithHoldingAmount)) - (SUM(t.SaleTaxAmount)+SUM(t.FurtherTaxAmount)) ) as Value ,sum(isnull(t.Quantity,0)) as Quantity ,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName
,t.UnitWeight from (
select
SUM(QuantityInvoiced) as Quantity,tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, 0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount,sum(tab.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, SUM(ExciseDutyActualAmount) as FurtherTaxAmount, sum(tab.FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount,sum(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, sum(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable ,sum(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone,LogoImage, CompanyFax ,sum(AdvanceAmount)AdvanceAmount , SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance)FurtherTaxAdvance ,tab.FiscalID ,tab.CompanyID ,tab.ItemCategoryID ,tab.InvoiceDate ,tab.UnitWeight from (
Select * from (
Select INV_Item.UnitWeight, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemCategoryID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID, ARS.CustomerName As BilledtoName, ARS.AddressLine1 AS BilledtoAddress, ARS.ZipCode As BilledtoZipCode, ARS.PhoneNumber AS BilledtoPhone, SC.CityName As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo, SAL_OrderHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID in @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID) Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID
INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID
left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID
Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
Union All
Select null as UnitWeight, null as ItemCategoryID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID ,SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID , '' As BilledtoName, '' AS BilledtoAddress, '' As BilledtoZipCode, '' AS BilledtoPhone, '' As BilledtoCity, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as InvoiceHeaderID, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate,
SET_DocumentType.DocumentType AS InvoiceType, (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),1,2) +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),4,1) +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber, 0 AS DispatchNo, 0 AS DeliveryOrderNo, 0 as ContractNo,DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, FORMAT( Convert(int , isnull(replace(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,'-','' ),0)), '#######-#') as NTNNumber, '' as InvoicedDescription, AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 AS CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.ZipCode AS CustomerZipCode, CityCust.CityName AS CustomerCity, AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber AS CustomerPhone, '' AS Terms, '' As ItemDescription, '' as UOMName, 0 as QuantityInvoiced, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description As InvoiceComments, Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoicedTo, 0 as UnitPrice, 0 as TaxAmount, SET_Currency.CurrencySign, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount, 0 as FEDAmount, ISNULL((select LookupDetail.EnumeratedDescription from LookupDetail where LookUpDetailID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode and LookupHeaderID = 5), '') as DocumentStatus , '0' as ItemCode, SAL_InvoiceHeader.Billedtoid AS BilledTo, 0 as Discount ,'0' as CustomerRefNo , 0 as WithHolding, 0 as ExclusiveSalesTaxAmount , 0 as SaleTaxAmount , 0 as ExciseDutyActualAmount , 0 as FEDTaxAmount , 0 as WithHoldingAmount ,0 as BrokerID, '' as DealerName, '' as SaleOrderDate , Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as AmountReceivable,
Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount as ActualInvoiceAmount ,'0' as DTRENo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DTREDate ,0 as AdvanceAmount,0,0 ,Convert(int,0)Inclusive from SAL_InvoiceHeader
left Join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Status = 1
inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID
Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId
Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId
Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND (@DocumentTypeID is null OR SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID) Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID Inner Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID
Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID
Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID in @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 )FinalTAB
Where FinalTAB.InvoiceType like '%Sales Invoice%Bagasse%' AND FinalTAB.InvoiceDate < @AsOnDate and FinalTAB.InvoiceDate > DATEADD(YEAR,-(select count(distinct StartDate) from SET_PeriodCustom),@AsOnDate)
)tab
group by tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount,tab.CompanyName,tab.CompanyAddressLine1,tab.CompanyAddressLine1 ,tab.CompanyAddressLine2,tab.CompanyAddressLine3,tab.CompanyZipCode,tab.CompanyCity,tab.CompanyPhone,tab.Logoimage,tab.CompanyFax,tab.FiscalID,tab.CompanyID ,tab.ItemCategoryID,tab.InvoiceDate,tab.UnitWeight
)t
inner join SET_PeriodCustom on SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalId = t.FiscalID and SET_PeriodCustom.CompanyID = t.CompanyID inner JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = t.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = t.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.[Status] = 1
group by INV_SET_Category.CategoryName ,SET_PeriodCustom.EndDate,t.InvoiceDate,INV_SET_Category.CategoryID,SET_PeriodCustom.PeriodSetName,t.UnitWeight
) DT GROUP BY DT.ItemCategoryID,DT.CategoryName, DT.YYMM, DT.MMM,CurrentFiscal,PeriodSetName,UnitWeight

data.name: Query_ServiceSalesInvoiceReport

--Declare @CompanyID int = 1 --Declare @PeriodID int = 1 --Declare @CurrentFiscalID int = 3
SELECT [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber ,SET_Business.BusinessName +' '+ SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierName, DocumentTypesGroup.Comments as SupplierAddress ,SET_OperatingUnit.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN,DocumentTypesGroup.BranchPh as SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_OperatingUnit.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName ,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as CustomerAddress,AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as CustomerNTN,AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as CustomerPhoneNumber ,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as CustomeSTRN,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ContractNo as DispatchNo,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemStatusCode,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,Abs(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) AS [BaseQuantity] ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, --(isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount],0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable ,--[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount + (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[GrossAmount],0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TotalAmount ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount +
(((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100) + (((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].FedAmount,0)) / 100)
)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0) as TotalAmount
, isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].FedAmount,0) as AdvanceTaxAmount ,(((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].FedAmount,0)) / 100) as AdvanceTax ,SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage as LogoImage ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerAddress as Shipto,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].Description as DescriptionTagNo, SAL_InvoiceDetail.DiscountAmountTaken ,(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+'SI' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + '000' +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as SINumber ,SAL_OrderHeader.referenceno as CustomerRefNo ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 FROM [SAL_InvoiceHeader] INNER JOIN [SAL_InvoiceDetail] On [SAL_InvoiceDetail].InvoiceHeaderID =[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].CompanyID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND [SAL_InvoiceDetail].PeriodID=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN [INV_StockTransactionDetail] ON [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionDetailID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockDetailID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[StockHeaderID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] = [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[Status] = 1 left JOIN [INV_StockTransactionHeader] ON [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[StockTransactionID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[StockTransactionID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[CompanyID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].[PeriodID] AND [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[Status] = 1 left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID=[SAL_InvoiceDetail].ItemID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on [SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and SET_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID -- inner join Set_PeriodCustom spc_dispatch on [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchDate between spc_dispatch.StartDate and spc_dispatch.EndDate --and spc_dispatch.Status = 1 and spc_dispatch.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID Left JOIN Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail on Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceHeaderID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].SourceLineID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].CompanyID AND Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = [INV_StockTransactionDetail].PeriodID left Join SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.[CompanyID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[CompanyID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[PeriodID] = [SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail].[PeriodID] AND SAL_OrderHeader.[Status] = 1 left JOIN INV_SET_Category On INV_SET_Category.CategoryID =INV_Item.ItemTypeID --AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID =INV_Item.CompanyID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CustomerID --AND AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer BC ON BC.CustomerID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid --AND BC.CompanyID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = [SAL_InvoiceHeader].PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId=[SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID AND SET_Company.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_OperatingUnit On SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId=SET_Company.OperatingUnitId AND SET_OperatingUnit.Status=1 INNER JOIN SET_Business On SET_Business.BusinessId=SET_Company.BusinessId and SET_Business.IsActive=1 INNER Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType And Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 LEFT Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And WHERE [SAL_InvoiceHeader].[Status] = 1 AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[CompanyID] = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) AND ([SAL_InvoiceHeader].[PeriodID] = @PeriodID OR @PeriodID is null)

data.name: Query_TaxInvoiceSteelReport
data.value:
SELECT Distinct [SAL_InvoiceHeader].CompanyID,SET_DocumentType.DocumentType as InvoiceType ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceID ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceDate,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].Description ,[SAL_InvoiceHeader].InvoiceNumber, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo as DeliveryOrderNo --,Sal_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced as Quantity --, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount , --case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' --then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) --else 0 end case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then ((
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) - --Withholding ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding)) ) / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount ) ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0) end ) else 0 end as SaleTaxAmount , --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount) case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end
as FEDTaxAmount , ((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding)) as WithHoldingAmount
,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ,INV_Item.UnitWeight
, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SalesTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding as WithHoldingTaxPer ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as ExciseDutyAmountTaxPer ,[SAL_ContractHeader].DTRENo , [SAL_ContractHeader].DTREDate --,Round((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight) * [SAL_OrderDetail].PriceperKG),0) As AmountReceivable ,((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced ) * ISNULL(SAL_ContractDetail.Rate,SAL_OrderDetail.Rate) )) As AmountReceivable ,SET_Business.BusinessName as SupplierName ,SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName as SupplierNameComplete ,SET_Business.AddressLine1 as SupplierAddress ,SET_Business.NTNNumber as SupplierNTN, SET_Business.PhoneNumber as SupplierPhoneNumber , SET_Business.SalesTaxNumber as SupplierSTRN, [SAL_InvoiceHeader].billedtoid, BC.CustomerName as BIllTo,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName --,AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as CustomerAddress, ,(case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 else [SAL_DispatchHeader].BiltyAddress end) as CustomerAddress, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as CustomerNTN,AR_SET_Customer.PhoneNumber as CustomerPhoneNumber ,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as CustomeSTRN --,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber, ,case when isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter,0) =1 or isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) = 1 then AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber else [SAL_DispatchHeader].DriverCNIC end as CNICNumber, [SAL_DispatchHeader].DispatchNo as DispatchNo,INV_Item.Description as ItemDescription ,INV_Item.InventoryItemStatusCode as ItemStatusCode,INV_SET_Category.CategoryName,Abs([INV_StockTransactionDetail].[TransactionQuantity]) AS [BaseQuantity] --,[INV_StockTransactionDetail].Transactioncost as UnitPrice ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as UnitPrice ,[SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],[SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount, [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_GrossAmount], --(isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].NetAmount,0) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount]) as TaxPayable
(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then --SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )

(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 34 No (SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) --+ --(SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity --)
else (SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) end)
end) else
case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity + (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) / (100+ SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount)) end end ) as AmountReceivable,
--([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + -- (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then -- Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 -- else -- 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount,
( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced *
(select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) - (isnull(TUnitPrice,0) * SalesTaxPercent / (100 + SalesTaxPercent)) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)
) as ActualInvoiceAmount ,SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo, SAL_OrderHeader.DTREDate ,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate,AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber From SAL_InvoiceDetail Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionDetail ON INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 Left JOIN [SAL_DispatchHeader] ON [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DocumentTypeID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentTypeID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[DispatchNo] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[DocumentNo] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[CompanyID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[CompanyID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[PeriodID] = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].[PeriodID] AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].[Status] = 1 AND [SAL_DispatchHeader].FiscalID = [INV_StockTransactionHeader].FiscalID
LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Inner Join SET_DocumentType ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID --DocumentTypesGroup.CompanyID = Set_DocumentType.CompanyID And INNER Join AR_SET_Customer ON AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID --AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And -- And AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID left JOIN AR_SET_Customer Brokername ON Brokername.CustomerID = SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID -- AND AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID Inner Join INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID Inner Join SET_Currency ON SET_Currency.CurrencyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceCurrencyID Left Join SET_City AS CityCust ON CityCust.CityID = AR_SET_Customer.CityID Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID Left Join SET_Term ON SET_Term.TermID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.TermsID Left Join SET_UnitOfMeasure ON SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID = SET_UnitOfMeasure.UOMID Left Join AR_SET_Customer ARS ON ARS.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.billedtoid --And ARS.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID And ARS.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
Left Join SET_City AS SC ON SC.CityID = ARS.CityID inner join Set_PeriodCustom on INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoFrom or @InvoiceNoFrom is null) And (SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNoTo or @InvoiceNoTo is null) --And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) And (SAL_ContractHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) And (SAL_ContractHeader.CustomerID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null)
Union All

--left Join Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.CompanyID -- And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.PeriodID -- And SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And Sal_Invoice_AccountsDetail.Status = 1

data.value:
SELECT distinct * FROM ( SELECT INV_Item.UnitWeight, SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.DeliveryOrderNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID AS StockDetailID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AS StockHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID, INV_StockTransactionHeader.Comments, SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID,SAL_OrderDetail.WithHolding, Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end as UnitQuantity, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) AS QuantityInvoiced, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SerialNo, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID, INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.CreatedByValue, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdatedBy, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdateDate, INV_StockTransactionDetail.UpdatedByValue, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then SAL_OrderDetail.ItemCategoryID else StockCat.CategoryID ENd as ItemCategoryID, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID else StockItem.ItemID ENd as ItemID, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then INV_Item.Description else StockItem.Description ENd as ItemDescription,
Case when (SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 and SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate is null) then ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) / (1 + (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, 0)) / 100) else --INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost SAL_OrderDetail.Rate ENd * (Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID =ISNULL(INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode,StockItem.VolumeUOMCode) then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,StockItem.WeightUOMCode) then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) as UnitPrice, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 and SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate is null then ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) else INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost ENd * (Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode,StockItem.VolumeUOMCode) then ISNULL(StockItem.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.WeightUOMCode,StockItem.WeightUOMCode) then ISNULL(StockItem.UnitWeight, 1) end) as RetailPrice, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) * ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end) * ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) * Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity)) end) else ABS(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionCost + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) End as BaseAmount, Case when ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive, 0) = 1 then ( Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then ( ( (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) ) --now calculating taxation - (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType LIKE '%Bagass%' THEN ( (case when SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate] is not null then ((( ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.[T_Rate],[SAL_OrderDetail].[Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * ( Case when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1)) when SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then (ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1)) end ) * ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ( select isnull(sum(ReversedQuantity), 0) from SAL_ReverseDetail where SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceCode = SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchID and SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceDocumentTypeID = SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.stockTransactionID and SAL_ReverseDetail.sourceDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID and SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID and SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID ) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID Where Sal_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID ), 0)) -- )*(isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount,0)+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,1))/(100+isnull(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount,0))) else else ( ( Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) - ISNULL( ( Select Sum(SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced) from Sal_InvoiceHeader INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceDetail on Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) else ABS (( (case when [SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate] is null then ((ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate]) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.FEDAmount, 0) + ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, 0)) / 100) else (ISNULL([SAL_OrderDetail].[T_Rate],SAL_OrderDetail.[Rate]) + ((Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Dispatch%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 and (SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Ubaro%' OR SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName like '%Channu%')) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) * INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) end) * ( Case when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = ISNULL(INV_Item.PrimaryUOMCode,StockItem.PrimaryUOMCode) then 1 when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.VolumeUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitVolume, 1) when INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID = INV_Item.WeightUOMCode then ISNULL(INV_Item.UnitWeight, 1) end ) ))end)end as GrossAmount, -- SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Quantity * sal_orderdetail.BaseAmount as GrossAmount, Abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) AS BaseQuantity, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID else UOM.UOMID ENd as ItemUnitID, Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then INV_SET_Category.CategoryName else StockCat.CategoryName ENd as CategoryName, --NetAmount (case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=

then

end) else
case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) else (abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (((abs(INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity) * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)) * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount] /100) end end ) as NetAmount,
Case when SAL_DispatchHeader.ISDirectDispatch = 0 then abs(ISNULL(ISNULL(INV_Item.ListPricePerUnit, 0) * (INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionQuantity), 0)) else INV_StockTransactionDetail.Amount TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.itemid and SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) as T_Rate, SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo, -1 as InvoiceHeaderID, -1 as InvoiceDetailID , SAL_DispatchHeader.CostCentreID ,[SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate as SaleOrderDate ,SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate as SaleContractDate ,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate ,SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG,ISNULL(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0)FreightDetail ,SAL_ContractHeader.DTRENo FROM INV_StockTransactionDetail INNER JOIN INV_StockTransactionHeader ON INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID LEft JOIN INV_SET_Category ON INV_SET_Category.CategoryID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemCategoryID AND INV_SET_Category.CompanyID = SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID AND INV_SET_Category.Status = 1 LEft JOIN INV_Item ON INV_Item.ItemID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID AND INV_Item.Status = 1 LEft JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure ON SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemUnitID AND SET_UnitofMeasure.Status = 1 ---------- For Order Number ---------- left JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderHeader.CompanyID AND StockCat.Status = 1 LEft JOIN SET_UnitofMeasure as UOM ON UOM.UOMID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionUOMID AND UOM.Status = 1

inner join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1

--- SaleRegisterCustomerBilledToWise_Steel -- --Declare @CompanyID int = 1 , -- @PeriodID int = 1 , -- @BrokerID int = null , -- @FromDate datetime = '2022-02-01 00:00:00:000', -- @ToDate datetime = '2022-02-28 00:00:00:000' -- @CurrentFiscalID int= 9
Select CompanyName, RTrim(Ltrim(FinalTab2.CustomerName)) as CustomerName, Sum(FinalTab2.Quantity) as QuantityInvoiced, sum(FinalTab2.NetAmount) as AmountReceivable, Count(FinalTab2.InvoiceNumber) as InvoiceNumber, Round(SUM( SaleTaxAmount),0) as SaleTaxAmount, SUM(FinalTab2.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(FinalTab2.AdvanceAmount) as AdvanceAmount, SUM(FinalTab2.FurtherTaxAdvance) as FurtherTaxAdvance, SUM(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, FinalTab2.Inclusive from ( Select
TAB.CustomerName, Count(distinct TAB.InvoiceNumber) as InvoiceNumber, TAB.InvoiceDate, Sum(Quantity) as Quantity, --TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAB.FEDAmount, SUM(FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount, SUM(TAB.FurtherTaxAdvance) as FurtherTaxAdvance, Round(SUM( SaleTaxAmount),0) as SaleTaxAmount, SUM(Tab.AdvanceAmount) as AdvanceAmount, Sum(TAB.ValueTaxAmountReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, Round(SUM(FurtherTaxAmount),0) as FurtherTaxAmount, SUM(FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount, SUM(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable , SUM(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SUM(TAB.AvgRate) as AvgRate, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.NetAmount,Round (TAB.TaxPayable ,0) as TaxPayable ,TAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount ,Tab.Inclusive from ( Select SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount , ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance, Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive, SAL_InvoiceDetail.unitprice as AvgRate , ---Other (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate , 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,2))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, Case --When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then '1703 - Molasses resulting from the extraction or refining of sugar' When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Billet%' then '7207A - IRON & NON-ALLOY STEEL BILLETS' end as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ),2) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
, --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount)) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) (case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end ) as SaleTaxAmount
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) as ValueTaxAmountReturn,
-- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end
as FurtherTaxAmount
, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount,2) as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))),2) As AmountReceivable, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ),0) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber,
SAL_ContractDetail.Rate * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced as NetAmount, ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount
from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID Inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID left join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType in @DocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1
)TAB

)FinalTab2

Select CompanyName, RTrim(Ltrim(FinalTab2.CustomerName)) as CustomerName, RTrim(Ltrim(FinalTab2.BrokerName)) as BrokerName, Sum(FinalTab2.Quantity) as QuantityInvoiced, sum(FinalTab2.NetAmount) as AmountReceivable, Count(FinalTab2.InvoiceNumber) as InvoiceNumber, Round(SUM( SaleTaxAmount),0) as SaleTaxAmount, SUM(FinalTab2.ExciseDutyActualAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount, SUM(FinalTab2.AdvanceAmount) as AdvanceAmount, SUM(FinalTab2.FurtherTaxAdvance) as FurtherTaxAdvance, SUM(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, FinalTab2.Inclusive from ( Select
TAB.CustomerName, TAB.BrokerName, Count(distinct TAB.InvoiceNumber) as InvoiceNumber, TAB.InvoiceDate, Sum(Quantity) as Quantity, --TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAB.FEDAmount, SUM(FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount, SUM(TAB.FurtherTaxAdvance) as FurtherTaxAdvance, Round(SUM( SaleTaxAmount),0) as SaleTaxAmount, SUM(Tab.AdvanceAmount) as AdvanceAmount, Sum(TAB.ValueTaxAmountReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, Round(SUM(FurtherTaxAmount),0) as FurtherTaxAmount, SUM(FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount, SUM(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, SUM(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable , SUM(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount, SUM(TAB.AvgRate) as AvgRate, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.NetAmount,Round (TAB.TaxPayable ,0) as TaxPayable ,TAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount ,Tab.Inclusive from ( Select SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as CustomerName, Brokers.CustomerName as BrokerName, ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount , ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)FurtherTaxAdvance, Convert(int,ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive,0))Inclusive, SAL_InvoiceDetail.unitprice as AvgRate , ---Other (Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate , 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,2))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, Case --When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then '1703 - Molasses resulting from the extraction or refining of sugar' When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Billet%' then '7207A - IRON & NON-ALLOY STEEL BILLETS' end as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate,0) ),2) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
, --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount)) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount) (case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end ) as SaleTaxAmount
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) as ValueTaxAmountReturn,
-- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) case when isnull(SAL_OrderHeader.DTRENo,'') = '' then ( (Case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount )) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) else Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount,0) end) ) else 0 end
as FurtherTaxAmount
, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount,2) as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))),2) As AmountReceivable, Round(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ),0) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber,
SAL_ContractDetail.Rate * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced as NetAmount, ((isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].GrossAmount,0)-isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].DiscountAmountTaken,0)) * isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[TaxAmount],0)) / 100 as TaxPayable , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as ExciseDutyActualAmount
from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1
Left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
Left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer Brokers on Brokers.CustomerID = SAL_ContractHeader.BrokerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID
Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 Inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID Inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID left join Set_PeriodCustom on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between Set_PeriodCustom.StartDate and Set_PeriodCustom.EndDate and Set_PeriodCustom.Status = 1 and Set_PeriodCustom.FiscalID = @CurrentFiscalID
where SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType in @DocumentTypeID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 {0} )TAB
Group BY TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.InvoiceDate, TAB.WithHolding, TAB.TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAb.FEDAmount, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.NetAmount,TAB.TaxPayable,TAB.ExciseDutyActualAmount ,TAB.CustomerName ,TAB.BrokerName ,TAB.FurtherTaxAdvance ,Tab.Inclusive
)FinalTab2
where FinalTab2.InvoiceDate between @FromDate and @ToDate group by FinalTab2.CompanyName, RTrim(Ltrim(FinalTab2.CustomerName)), FinalTab2.InvoiceNumber, FinalTab2.Inclusive,FinalTab2.BrokerName Order bY RTrim(Ltrim(FinalTab2.CustomerName)) asc
