Select TAB.InvoiceID, TAB.BuyerNTN, TAB.BuyerCNICNo,TAB.BuyerName, TAB.CustomerCategoryID, TAB.CustomerCategory, TAB.Provinceid, TAB.ProvinceName, TAB.InvoiceType,TAB.DocumentType, TAB.InvoiceNumber , TAB.DocumentDate, case when TAB.DtreNO is not null then 'DTRE Goods' else TAB.SaleType end as SaleType, TAB.SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, case when TAB.DtreNO is not null then '0%' else TAB.Rate end as Rate, TAB.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, TAB.ItemName, Sum(Quantity) as Quantity, TAB.UOMName, TAB.WithHolding, case when TAB.DtreNO is not null then 0 else TAB.TaxAmount end as TaxAmount, TAB.ExciseDutyAmount, TAB.FEDAmount, Round(SUM(FixedSalesTaxAmount),0) as FixedSalesTaxAmount, case when TAB.DtreNO is not null then 0 else Round(SUM( SaleTaxAmount),0) end as SaleTaxAmount, Round(Sum(TAB.ValueTaxAmountReturn),0) as ValueSaleReturn, ROund(SUM(FurtherTaxAmount),0) as FurtherTaxAmount, Round(SUM(FEDTaxAmount),0) as FEDTaxAmount, SUM(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, Round(SUM(AmountReceivable),0) as AmountReceivable , Round(SUM(ActualInvoiceAmount),0) as ActualInvoiceAmount, TAB.BuyerSTRNNumber, TAB.CompanyName, TAB.CompanyAddressLine1, TAB.CompanyAddressLine2, TAB.CompanyAddressLine3, TAB.CompanyZipCode, TAB.CompanyCity, TAB.CompanyPhone, TAB.Logoimage, TAB.CompanyFax,DTRENo,round(sum(AdvanceAmount),0) as AdvanceAmount from ( Select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN,
Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end))+'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +' '+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I' +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Molasses%' then '1703 - Molasses resulting from the extraction or refining of sugar' When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Bagasse%' then '2303 - Residues of starch manufacture, similar residues beet-pulp, bagasse and other waste of sugar manufacture, brewing or distilling dregs and waste, whether or not in the form of pellets' end as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) )) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
--, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount / 100) as SaleTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100 + [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end ) as SaleTaxAmount
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].Rate) as ValueTaxAmountReturn, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount) as FurtherTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount) as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
-- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) As AmountReceivable,
(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 34 No (SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced)
else (SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else
case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity + (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end end )as AmountReceivable, (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) )) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, SET_OperatingUnit.Logoimage, select (tab.InvoiceID),(tab.BuyerNTN),(tab.BuyerCNICNo),(tab.BuyerCNIC2),(tab.BuyerName),(tab.CustomerPartyName),(CustomerCategoryID) ,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType), (tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, sum(tab.Quantity) as Quantity,tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, sum(tab.FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount,sum(tab.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, Sum(tab.ValueSaleReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, sum(tab.FurtherTaxAmount) as FurtherTaxAmount, sum(tab.FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount,sum(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, sum(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable ,sum(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount,BuyerSTRNNumber,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone,LogoImage, CompanyFax ,sum(AdvanceAmount)AdvanceAmount , SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance)FurtherTaxAdvance ,case when sum(AdvanceAmount) > 0 then 3 else 1 end as Adjusted from ( Select distinct SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN, --Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else (case when isnull((select FieldValue1 from Set_Parameter where FieldName = 'IsRaniPurSugarMill'),'') = 'True' then CustomerParty.CNICNumber else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end ) end as BuyerCNICNo,
Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNIC2, CustomerParty.CustomerName as CustomerPartyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, --'SI' +'-'+ Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' Then 'S' else '' end as DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1) +'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, '1701B - Cane Sugar' as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) ) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
,
SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount
*
(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate AND ISNULL(SET_SalesTaxParameters.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount ))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount/ 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 AND ISNULL(pm.IsRegistered,0) = isnull(AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered,0) order by CreateDate desc ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) end)
end) else --(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount] + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) ) -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount) / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) ) )
( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] - (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) )
-- / (100+ [SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount + isnull([SAL_ContractDetail].[ExciseDutyAmount],0) )
end )
/ (100 + SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount + isnull(Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.FurtherTax,0)) as SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)) as ValueSaleReturn , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FurtherTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
--case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 -- then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive -- else -- --[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) -- end as AmountReceivable
case when SAL_InvoiceDetail.Inclusive = 1 then (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else --SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG (sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight ) end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end )))
else
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else --SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG (sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight ) end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) + (
(([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * case when COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) > 0 then COnvert(decimal(18,6),ISNULL(SAL_COntractHeader.FreightDetail,0)) else ( (case when SAL_ContractHeader.ContractNo is null then SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG else --SAL_ContractDetail.PricePerKG (sal_invoicedetail.unitprice / INV_Item.UnitWeight ) end ) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)) end ))) * (isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].TaxAmount,0) + isnull([SAL_InvoiceDetail].ExciseDutyAmount,0)) / 100 )
end as AmountReceivable
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax
,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID PaymentID as InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerCNICNo,'' BuyerCNIC2,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as BuyerName,'' as CustomerPartyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory , AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName , '' as InvoiceType, 'APR' as DocumentType, convert(varchar,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo) as InvoiceNumber,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate as DocumentDate,'' as SaleType, '' as Rate, 0 as ItemID ,'' as ItemName , AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Quantity,'' as UOMName, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.WithHoldingTax as WithHolding, 0 as TaxAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount,0 as FEDAmount,0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FEDAmount as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, 0 as FurtherTaxAmount, 0 as FEDTaxAmount, 0 as WithHoldingAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.AdvanceAmount as AmountReceivable, 0 as ActualInvoiceAmount, '' as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode ,CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone,null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax ,0 as AdvanceAmount, 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance ,2 as Adjusted from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1 and RecievingDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID And (AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)
union all
select SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID as InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerCNICNo,''BuyerCNIC2,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as BuyerName,'' as CustomerPartyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory , AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName , '' as InvoiceType, 'SIR' as DocumentType, convert(varchar,SAL_ReverseHeader.DocumentNo) as InvoiceNumber,SAL_ReverseHeader.CreateDate as DocumentDate,'' as SaleType, '' as Rate, 0 as ItemID ,'' as ItemName , SAL_ReverseDetail.ReversedQuantity as Quantity,'' as UOMName, 0 as WithHolding, 0 as TaxAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount,0 as FEDAmount,0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount, 0 as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, 0 as FurtherTaxAmount, 0 as FEDTaxAmount, 0 as WithHoldingAmount, 0 as AmountReceivable, 0 as ActualInvoiceAmount, '' as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode ,CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone,null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax ,0 as AdvanceAmount, 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance ,1 as Adjusted from SAL_ReverseHeader Inner Join SAL_ReverseDetail on SAL_ReverseHeader.ReverseHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.ReverseHeaderID And SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ReverseDetail.CompanyID And SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID
Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_ReverseDetail.SourceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_ReverseDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1
Inner Join SAL_InvoiceHeader on SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID -- AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where SAL_ReverseHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_ReverseHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 --And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = Null or Null is null) {0}
-- Order By CustomerCategory,InvoiceNumber

select tab.BuyerAddress,(tab.InvoiceID),(tab.BuyerNTN),(tab.BuyerCNICNo),(tab.BuyerName),(tab.CustomerPartyName),(CustomerCategoryID) ,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType), (tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, sum(tab.Quantity) as Quantity,tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, sum(tab.FixedSalesTaxAmount) as FixedSalesTaxAmount,sum(tab.SaleTaxAmount) as SaleTaxAmount, Sum(tab.ValueSaleReturn) as ValueSaleReturn, sum(tab.FurtherTaxAmount) as FurtherTaxAmount, sum(tab.FEDTaxAmount) as FEDTaxAmount,sum(WithHoldingAmount) as WithHoldingAmount, sum(AmountReceivable) as AmountReceivable ,sum(ActualInvoiceAmount) as ActualInvoiceAmount,BuyerSTRNNumber,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone,LogoImage, CompanyFax ,sum(AdvanceAmount)AdvanceAmount , SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance)FurtherTaxAdvance ,case when sum(AdvanceAmount) > 0 then 3 else 1 end as Adjusted ,tab.RateExcludingSaleTax from ( Select distinct AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as BuyerAddress, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, case when AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then isnull(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber) else isnull(CustomerParty.NTNNumber,CustomerParty.CNICNumber) end as BuyerNTN, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, CustomerParty.CustomerName as CustomerPartyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, (case when Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory like '%exempt%' then 'EXEMPTED' else (case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end) end) as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, --'SI' +'-'+ Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' Then 'S' else '' end as DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1) +'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, --'1701B - Cane Sugar' as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) ) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.SalesTaxParameterID) = 1 then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end ) as SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)) as ValueSaleReturn , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FurtherTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
--case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 -- then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive -- else -- --[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) -- end as AmountReceivable
(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 34 No ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced)
else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else
case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity + (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end end ) as AmountReceivable
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax
,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)FurtherTaxAdvance,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo , SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as RateExcludingSaleTax ,SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockHeaderID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.TransactionDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.StockDetailID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionDetail.Status=1 inner Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail ON SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DOHeaderID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1 Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID -- AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) {0} )tab
group by (tab.InvoiceID),(tab.BuyerNTN),(tab.BuyerCNICNo),(tab.BuyerName),(tab.CustomerPartyName),(CustomerCategoryID) ,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType),(tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, BuyerSTRNNumber,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone, CompanyFax,LogoImage,tab.BuyerAddress , tab.RateExcludingSaleTax

Cane Sugar' as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) ) as FixedSalesTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end ) as SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)) as ValueSaleReturn , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FurtherTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
--case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 -- then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive -- else -- --[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate -- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) -- end as AmountReceivable
(case when ( SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate else (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 34 No ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced)
else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) + (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced else SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else
case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity else ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_ContractDetail.rate)--SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity + (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].[NetAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end end ) as AmountReceivable
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax
,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)FurtherTaxAdvance,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo , select AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as BuyerAddress, PaymentID as InvoiceID, isnull(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber) as BuyerNTN, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerCNICNo,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as BuyerName,'' as CustomerPartyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID,
--case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' --else (Case When -- AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else --'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory
(case when Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory like '%exempt%' then 'EXEMPTED' else (case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end) end) as CustomerCategory
, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName , '' as InvoiceType, 'APR' as DocumentType, convert(varchar,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo) as InvoiceNumber,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate as DocumentDate,'' as SaleType, '' as Rate, 0 as ItemID ,'' as ItemName , AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Quantity,'' as UOMName, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.WithHoldingTax as WithHolding, 0 as TaxAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount,0 as FEDAmount,0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FEDAmount as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, 0 as FurtherTaxAmount, 0 as FEDTaxAmount, 0 as WithHoldingAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.AdvanceAmount as AmountReceivable, 0 as ActualInvoiceAmount, '' as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode ,CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone,null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax ,0 as AdvanceAmount, 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance ,2 as Adjusted ,0 as RateExcludingSaleTax from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID -- AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1 and RecievingDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID And (AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)

AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 inner Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
left join ar_set_Customer CustomerParty on CustomerParty.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID and CustomerParty.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) And (SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerPartyID = @CustomerID or @CustomerID is null) {0} )tab where isnull(AdvanceAmount,0) > 0 group by (tab.InvoiceID),(tab.BuyerNTN),(tab.BuyerCNICNo),(tab.BuyerName),(tab.CustomerPartyName),(CustomerCategoryID) ,(tab.CustomerCategory),(tab.Provinceid),(tab.ProvinceName),(tab.InvoiceType), (tab.DocumentType),(tab.InvoiceNumber),tab.DocumentDate,tab.SaleType,tab.Rate,tab.ItemID,tab.ItemName, tab.UOMName,tab.WithHolding,tab.GovtLevisAmount,tab.TaxonGovtLevis,tab.FurtherTaxonGovtLevis,tab.TaxAmount,tab.ExciseDutyAmount,tab.FEDAmount, BuyerSTRNNumber,CompanyName ,CompanyAddressLine1,CompanyAddressLine2,CompanyAddressLine3,CompanyZipCode,CompanyCity,CompanyPhone, CompanyFax,LogoImage,tab.BuyerAddress , tab.RateExcludingSaleTax
union all
select AR_SET_Customer.AddressLine1 as BuyerAddress, PaymentID as InvoiceID, isnull(AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber,AR_SET_Customer.CNICNumber) as BuyerNTN, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerCNICNo,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as BuyerName,'' as CustomerPartyName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID,
--case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' --else (Case When -- AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else --'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory
(case when Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory like '%exempt%' then 'EXEMPTED' else (case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end) end) as CustomerCategory
, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName , '' as InvoiceType, 'APR' as DocumentType, convert(varchar,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo) as InvoiceNumber,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate as DocumentDate,'' as SaleType, '' as Rate, 0 as ItemID ,'' as ItemName , AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Quantity,'' as UOMName, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.WithHoldingTax as WithHolding, 0 as TaxAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount,0 as FEDAmount,0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FEDAmount as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, 0 as FurtherTaxAmount, 0 as FEDTaxAmount, 0 as WithHoldingAmount,0 as GovtLevisAmount,0 as TaxonGovtLevis,0 as FurtherTaxonGovtLevis, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.AdvanceAmount as AmountReceivable, 0 as ActualInvoiceAmount, '' as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode ,CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone,null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax ,0 as AdvanceAmount, 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance ,2 as Adjusted ,0 as RateExcludingSaleTax from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID -- AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1
Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1 and RecievingDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID And (AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)
Order By DocumentDate,InvoiceNumber asc

( Select SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerCNICII end as BuyerCNICNo, Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered=1 then AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName Else SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerNameII end as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, --Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategory, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory, AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType, --Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, --'SI' +'-'+ Case When Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' Then 'S' else '' end as DocumentType, 'SI' as DocumentType,
(Case DocumentTypesGroup.GroupName when 'Head Office-KHI' then 'K'+substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1) +'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) when null then '-' +substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) else SUBSTRING(GroupName,1,1)+ substring((Replace(SET_DocumentType.DocumentType,' ','')),14,1)+'I'+Convert(varchar(5),(case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'E' else ( case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Un-R%' then 'U' else 'R' end) end)) +'-'+ substring(convert(varchar(20),year(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate)),3,2) + set_operatingunit.UnitPrefix +convert(varchar(24),SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber) end ) as InvoiceNumber , SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate as DocumentDate, 'Goods at standard rate (default)' as SaleType, --SAL_InvoiceDetail.UnitPrice as Rate, Convert(varchar(20), convert(int, Round(SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount,0))) +' %' as Rate, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID, --Inv_Item.Description as ItemName, '1701B - Cane Sugar' as ItemName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.Quantityinvoiced as Quantity, SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMName, SAL_InvoiceDetail.WithHolding, SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount, SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) ) as FixedSalesTaxAmount --, ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_OrderDetail].T_Rate / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.TaxAmount as SaleTaxAmount
,(case when ( SAL_OrderDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (case when
--SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' (select top 1 isnull(Inclusive,0) as Inclusive from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_OrderHeader.ContractDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) = 1
then (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) else ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) - ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) end ) )
then
(case when SAL_OrderDetail.Inclusive = 1 then --!st case Sugar 36 No (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity else
(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' then ( (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced--SAL_OrderDetail.Quantity else (select top 1 TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters pm where pm.Item = SAL_InvoiceDetail.itemid and SAL_InvoiceHeader.invoicedate between pm.FromDate and pm.ToDate and pm.Status = 1 and pm.IsActive = 1 order by CreateDate desc ) * SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_OrderDetail.SalesTaxAmount) end)
end) else ((( ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice ) - --WithHolding --WithHolding --((([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice)* ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / 100 ) (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * [SAL_InvoiceDetail].UnitPrice) * ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding)
) * [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100+ [SAL_OrderDetail].[SalesTaxAmount])) end )as SaleTaxAmount
--,(case when ( -- SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
-- (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' -- then -- SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate -- else -- (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) -- end ) -- )
-- then
-- (case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then -- --!st case Sugar 36 No -- SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity -- else
-- (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' -- then -- (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity -- else -- SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) -- end)
-- end) -- else -- (([SAL_ContractDetail].[GrossAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100)) -- end -- ) as SaleTaxAmount ,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc)) as ValueSaleReturn , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.ExciseDutyAmount as FurtherTaxAmount , ([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (select top 1 isnull(TUnitPrice,0) as TUnitPrice from SET_SalesTaxParameters where Status = 1 and SET_SalesTaxParameters.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and SET_SalesTaxParameters.Item = SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate between FromDate and ToDate order by SET_SalesTaxParameters.FromDate desc) / 100) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDAmount as FEDTaxAmount , (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * ( INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end)))) * ( [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding )) / (100 + [SAL_InvoiceDetail].WithHolding) as WithHoldingAmount,
-- (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + --(Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' -- and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) -- then 3.60 -- else -- 0 end))))) As AmountReceivable
case when isnull(SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive,0) > 0 then SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced * INV_Item.UnitWeight * SAL_ContractHeader.InvoiceRateExclusive else --[SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * SAL_OrderDetail.Rate (([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (INV_Item.UnitWeight * (SAL_OrderDetail.PricePerKG + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then 3.60 else 0 end))))) end as AmountReceivable
--(case when ( --SAL_ContractDetail.Rate <=
--(case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' --then -- SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate --else -- (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate - (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount))) --end ) -- )
-- then
-- (case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then -- --!st case Sugar 34 No -- (SAL_ContractDetail.quantity * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) -- + -- (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity)
-- else -- (SAL_ContractDetail.quantity * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) --+ -- (case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%billet%' -- then -- (SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / 100 ) * SAL_ContractDetail.Quantity -- else -- SAL_ContractDetail.T_Rate * SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount / (100 + SAL_ContractDetail.SalesTaxAmount) -- end)
-- end) -- else
-- case when SAL_ContractDetail.Inclusive = 1 then -- (SAL_ContractDetail.quantity * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) --else -- (SAL_ContractDetail.quantity * SAL_ContractDetail.rate) -- + -- (([SAL_ContractDetail].[GrossAmount] * [SAL_ContractDetail].[SalesTaxAmount]) / (100)) --end -- end -- ) as AmountReceivable
,([SAL_InvoiceDetail].QuantityInvoiced * (ISNULL(SAL_OrderDetail.Rate,0) + (Case When ([SAL_OrderHeader].ContractDate < '2019-07-01' and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like '%Sugar%' and AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 0 ) then Isnull(Inv_Item.UnitWeight,0) * 3.60 else 0 end)) ) as ActualInvoiceAmount, AR_SET_Customer.STRNNumber as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode, CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone, null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax
,ISNULL((Select SUM(AdvanceAmount) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)AdvanceAmount ,ISNULL((Select SUM(WHAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID),0)WHAdvance
,ISNULL((Select SUM(FurtherTaxAdvance) from SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment where SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.Status = 1 and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and SAL_InvoiceTaxPayment.InvoiceDetailID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceDetailID ),0)FurtherTaxAdvance ,Case when CustomerProvinceID = 1 then 'Balochistan' when CustomerProvinceID = 2 then 'KPK' when CustomerProvinceID = 3 then 'Punjab' when CustomerProvinceID = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end as CustomerProvince ,isnull(SAL_InvoiceDetail.FEDFixRate,0) * SAL_InvoiceDetail.QuantityInvoiced as FixFEDAmount from SAL_InvoiceHeader Inner Join SAL_InvoiceDetail on SAL_InvoiceDetail.FiscalID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status=1 Inner Join INV_StockTransactionDetail on INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.StockTransactionID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.CompanyID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.PeriodID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.FiscalID AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 inner Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID =
