SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.DODetailID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.SourceLineID AND SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderHeader ON SAL_OrderHeader.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderHeader.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderHeader.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderHeader.Status = 1 LEFT JOIN SAL_OrderDetail ON SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.CompanyID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderHeaderID AND SAL_OrderDetail.OrderDetailID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.SalesOrderDetailID AND SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID = SAL_DeliveryOrderDetail.PeriodID AND SAL_OrderDetail.Status=1 Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --And AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax on Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CustomerCategoryWiseTaxID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID -- AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND Set_CustomerCategoryWiseTax.Status = 1 inner Join Set_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID=SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.Status = 1 Left Join DocumentTypesGroup On DocumentTypesGroup.GroupID = Set_DocumentType.GroupID inner Join Inv_Item on Inv_Item.ItemID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemID --AND Inv_Item.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID AND Inv_Item.Status = 1 left Join SET_UnitofMeasure on SET_UnitofMeasure.UOMID = SAL_InvoiceDetail.ItemUnitID Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID
left join SAL_ContractDetail on SAL_ContractDetail.ContractDetailID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractDetailID and SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID = SAL_OrderDetail.ContractHeaderID and SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID =SAL_OrderDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID =SAL_OrderDetail.PeriodID and SAL_ContractDetail.ItemID =SAL_OrderDetail.ItemID and SAL_ContractDetail.Status = 1
left join SAL_ContractHeader on SAL_ContractHeader.ContractID = SAL_ContractDetail.ContractID and SAL_ContractHeader.CompanyID = SAL_ContractDetail.CompanyID and SAL_ContractHeader.PeriodID = SAL_ContractDetail.PeriodID
where SAL_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = @CompanyID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = @PeriodID And SAL_InvoiceDetail.Status = 1 And (SAL_OrderHeader.BrokerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null) {0} )tab

union all
select
PaymentID as InvoiceID, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerNTN, AR_SET_Customer.NTNNumber as BuyerCNICNo,AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName as BuyerName, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerCategoryID, case When AR_SET_Customer.IsExporter = 1 then 'EXPORTER' else (Case When AR_SET_Customer.IsRegistered = 1 then 'REGISTERED' else 'UNREGISTERED' end) end as CustomerCategory , AR_SET_Customer.Provinceid, case When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 1 then 'Balochistan' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 2 then 'KPK' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 3 then 'Punjab' When SET_OperatingUnit.Provinceid = 4 then 'Sindh' else 'Other' end As ProvinceName , '' as InvoiceType, 'APR' as DocumentType, convert(varchar,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.DocumentNo) as InvoiceNumber,AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.RecievingDate as DocumentDate,'' as SaleType, '' as Rate, 0 as ItemID ,'' as ItemName , AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Quantity,'' as UOMName, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.WithHoldingTax as WithHolding, 0 as TaxAmount, 0 as ExciseDutyAmount,0 as FEDAmount,0 as FixedSalesTaxAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.FEDAmount as SaleTaxAmount, 0 as ValueSaleReturn, 0 as FurtherTaxAmount, 0 as FEDTaxAmount, 0 as WithHoldingAmount, AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.AdvanceAmount as AmountReceivable, 0 as ActualInvoiceAmount, '' as BuyerSTRNNumber, SET_Business.BusinessName + ' - ' + SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitName AS CompanyName, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine1 AS CompanyAddressLine1, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine2 AS CompanyAddressLine2, SET_OperatingUnit.AddressLine3 AS CompanyAddressLine3, SET_OperatingUnit.ZipCode AS CompanyZipCode ,CityComp.CityName AS CompanyCity, SET_OperatingUnit.PhoneNumber AS CompanyPhone,null as Logoimage, SET_OperatingUnit.FaxNumber AS CompanyFax ,0 as AdvanceAmount, 0 as FurtherTaxAdvance ,2 as Adjusted,'' , 0 as FixFEDAmount from AP_AdvanceSugarPayment Inner Join AR_SET_Customer on AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID And AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID And AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Inner Join SET_Company ON SET_Company.CompanyId = AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID Inner Join SET_Business ON SET_Business.BusinessId = SET_Company.BusinessId Inner Join SET_OperatingUnit ON SET_OperatingUnit.OperatingUnitId = SET_Company.OperatingUnitId Left Join SET_City AS CityComp ON CityComp.CityID = SET_OperatingUnit.CityID where AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.Status = 1 and RecievingDate between @FromDate and @ToDate and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CompanyID = @CompanyID and AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.PeriodID = @PeriodID And (AP_AdvanceSugarPayment.CustomerID = @BrokerID or @BrokerID is null)
-- Order By CustomerCategory,InvoiceNumber
